title: Evaluation of the restricted symplectic form
statement: Fix a prime $p$ and let $\omega$ denote the symplectic form on $V = \bbf_p^{\,n} \times \bbf_p^{\,n}$. For a subset $M \subseteq \{0, \dots, n-1\}$ and any two vectors $x, y$ in the support submodule $V_M$, the restricted symplectic form evaluated at $(x, y)$ agrees with $\omega(x, y)$ computed on $x$ and $y$ regarded as elements of the ambient space $V$.
hypotheses_covered: M is a subset of the coordinate index set
x and y lie in the support submodule V_M
replaced: For $x,y \in V_M$, $\mathrm{sym\_form\_sub}_M(x,y) = \omega(x,y)$ computed on the underlying vectors.
